headline: The Planning Board reviewed traffic concerns for a proposed Costco warehouse, while the capital committee examined major DPW vehicle and water infrastructure requests.
synopsis: The Planning Board continued its public hearing on the proposed 167,000-square-foot Costco warehouse on Coslin Drive following extensive discussion on neighborhood traffic impacts, Route 9 intersections, and mitigation plans. In separate development actions, the board approved a 90-day temporary occupancy permit for Valvoline and endorsed as-builts and an occupancy recommendation for Fay School's building addition. Meanwhile, the Capital Improvement and Planning Committee reviewed FY28 capital requests with the Department of Public Works, focusing on $1.82 million for smart water meters, tank rehabilitation, and fleet replacements. The committee also received status updates on the Neary School renovation design and grant funding for Fay Park.

highlights.title: Costco warehouse traffic study and neighborhood impacts
highlights.why: The board reviewed revised traffic modeling for the proposed warehouse and gas station, continuing the hearing after neighbors and members raised concerns over Route 9 delays and cut-through truck traffic.

highlights.title: DPW and water infrastructure capital requests
highlights.why: DPW presented long-term capital priorities, including an estimated $1.82 million for smart water meters, $700,000 for water tank rehabilitation, and potential lead soil remediation costs.

highlights.title: Neary School renovation design and schedule
highlights.why: The committee received an update confirming the preferred path is a renovation of the existing building with a full-sized gymnasium, with cost estimates expected in mid-November.

highlights.title: Valvoline temporary occupancy permit approval
highlights.why: The board voted 4-0 to approve a 90-day temporary certificate of occupancy for 361 Turnpike Road subject to conditions covering plantings, lighting, and an easement.

highlights.title: Fay School building addition as-builts and occupancy
highlights.why: The board approved as-built plans and an updated landscape mitigation plan, voting to recommend issuance of an occupancy permit for the school's addition.
